hero.title:
Celebrity Xcel
Cruise Ship Guide
hero.subtitle: Celebrity Xcel is the newest addition to Celebrity Cruises' Edge Series, joining Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, Celebrity Beyond, and Celebrity Ascent.
hero.description: The ship combines the design concepts established by the Edge Series with additional dining, entertainment, outdoor, and destination-focused experiences.

atAGlance.title: Celebrity Xcel at a Glance
paragraphs: Celebrity Xcel entered service in November 2025 as the fifth ship in the Edge Series — designed around outward-facing spaces, innovative accommodations, multiple dining venues, and destination-focused experiences.

Celebrity's current fleet information places Xcel within its Edge Series alongside Edge, Apex, Beyond, and Ascent. Celebrity's official ship information lists Xcel's maiden voyage as November 18, 2025.

whatMakesDifferent.title: What Makes Celebrity Xcel Different?
subtitles: Celebrity Xcel builds on the design language introduced with the Edge Series rather than simply adding another conventional cruise ship to the fleet.
features: Large areas designed around ocean and destination views
Multiple restaurants, cafés, bars, and lounges
A mixture of contemporary indoor and outdoor areas
whatMakesDifferent.summary: The result is a ship designed to make the ocean and destinations part of the onboard experience rather than treating them simply as scenery outside the ship. Celebrity describes Xcel as combining the established Edge Series experiences with new spaces and food-and-drink concepts.

cabinsAndSuites.title: Celebrity Xcel Cabins and Suites
cabinsAndSuites.subtitle: Celebrity Xcel offers several accommodation categories — from economical inside rooms to ocean-view cabins, private verandas, the innovative Infinite Veranda, and premium suite accommodations through The Retreat.

cards.title: Inside Staterooms
cards.description: Enclosed accommodation without a private exterior view. Can accommodate up to four guests in selected configurations.

cards.title: Ocean View Staterooms
cards.description: Replace a traditional balcony with large windows overlooking the sea.

cards.title: Veranda Staterooms
cards.description: Provide a private outdoor balcony, with veranda sizes varying by category.

cards.title: Infinite Veranda Staterooms
cards.description: Allows the exterior space to become part of the stateroom through a floor-to-ceiling opening.

cards.title: Suites & The Retreat
cards.description: Suite accommodations associated with The Retreat, Celebrity's suite experience with dedicated spaces and services.

stateroomFeatures.title: What to Expect in Your Stateroom
stateroomFeatures.subtitle: STANDARD STATEROOM INCLUSIONS
items: Private luxury bathroom with modern fixtures
Interactive TV system for onboard services and movies
Premium amenities & dedicated service (Suites & The Retreat)
stateroomFeatures.tip: Tip: Compare the benefits included with each suite category rather than choosing solely by cabin size. Suite amenities and access can vary.

deckPlans.title: Celebrity Xcel Deck Plans & Navigation
deckPlans.subtitle: Celebrity Xcel has 17 decks. Choosing the right stateroom goes beyond the cabin category — your position on the deck plan matters just as much.

cards.title: Distance from Elevators
cards.description: Convenient for fast access to public venues, but potentially experiences higher foot traffic.

cards.title: Location Below Public Areas
cards.description: Important to review if you prefer quiet nights without overhead footstep sound from pool decks or buffets.

cards.title: Location Above Entertainment Venues
cards.description: Check carefully if you are sensitive to sound from late-night lounges, bars, or theater stages.

cards.title: Proximity to Pools
cards.description: Useful for travelers who prioritize outdoor access, sun loungers, and quick morning swim routines.

cards.title: Forward, Midship, or Aft Position
cards.description: Each offers a different onboard experience, with midship staterooms offering the highest vessel stability.

cards.title: Connecting Rooms
cards.description: Useful configurations for families and multi-generational groups traveling together on the same voyage.

cards.title: Accessible Cabins
cards.description: Designed with essential features such as wider doorways, roll-in showers, and grab bars where applicable.

cabinSelectionGuide.title: Choosing the Best Celebrity Xcel Cabin
cabinSelectionGuide.subtitle: There is no single cabin location ideal for every traveler. Match your primary priority to the right cabin type before booking. Tip: Check what is directly above, below, and beside your room.

cards.title: Lowest Accommodation Cost
cards.description: Inside Stateroom: Maximizes your travel budget while giving you full access to all ship amenities and public venues.

cards.title: Natural Light & Scenery
cards.description: Ocean View: Large picture window provides constant natural sunlight and stunning ocean vistas.

cards.title: Traditional Outdoor Space
cards.description: Veranda: A classic private step-out balcony for fresh open sea breezes and morning coffee.

cards.title: Indoor/Outdoor Flexibility
cards.description: Infinite Veranda: Blends the exterior space into your stateroom with a single touch of a button.

cards.title: More Space & Premium Benefits
cards.description: Suite / The Retreat: VIP perks, private Luminae dining, Retreat Lounge access, and dedicated concierge.

cards.title: Families & Groups
cards.description: Connecting or Larger Accommodations: Keeps everyone close together with shared spaces and easy communication.

cards.title: Mobility Considerations
cards.description: Accessible Stateroom: Specially configured layouts with barrier-free entry, wide doorways, and roll-in showers.

cards.title: Quiet Relaxation
cards.description: Cabins Away from High-Traffic Areas: Staterooms sandwiched between accommodation decks for total peace.

dining.title: Celebrity Xcel Dining Experience
dining.subtitle: Dining is a major part of the Xcel experience — from casual poolside bites to destination-inspired restaurants including Spice Café, Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, and Cyprus Restaurant.

profiles.name: Spice Café
profiles.quote: Spice Café is designed around destination-inspired flavors. Menus change with the destinations and festivals featured at The Bazaar, connecting onboard dining directly with the places you visit.
profiles.reason: Spice Café is designed around destination-inspired flavors. Celebrity describes its menus as changing with the destinations and festivals featured at The Bazaar. This makes it particularly relevant for travelers who want the food onboard to reflect the places they are visiting.
whyFits: Destination-inspired flavors curated for each sailing
Changing menus based on regional ports of call
Direct connection to The Bazaar cultural concept
Complimentary main dining experience included in fare

profiles.name: Oceanview Café
profiles.quote: Oceanview Café provides a marketplace-style dining experience with a broad selection of international flavors and flexible meal options throughout the day.
profiles.reason: Oceanview Café provides a marketplace-style dining experience with a broad selection of food and international flavors. It is a useful option for flexible meals when guests do not want a formal dining experience.
whyFits: Flexible dining times without set reservations
Extensive international cuisine and live cooking stations
Casual indoor and alfresco seating with ocean views
Complimentary breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

profiles.name: Mast Grill
profiles.quote: Mast Grill offers casual poolside dining, positioned for guests who want to eat fresh grilled favorites without leaving the outdoor pool area.
profiles.reason: Mast Grill offers casual poolside dining, including burgers and other relaxed fare. It is positioned for guests who want to eat without leaving the outdoor pool area.
whyFits: Convenient poolside dining on sunny sea days
Freshly prepared burgers, hot dogs, and casual fare
No need to change out of swimwear or cover-ups
Complimentary casual dining on the open pool deck

profiles.name: Cyprus Restaurant
profiles.quote: Cyprus Restaurant focuses on Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, highlighting fresh seafood and clean, simple flavors celebrating coastal culinary traditions.
profiles.reason: Cyprus Restaurant focuses on Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, with seafood and clean, simple flavors highlighted by Celebrity. It is one of the featured dining venues on Celebrity Xcel.
whyFits: Fresh seafood selections and regional olive oils
Clean, simple flavors celebrating coastal traditions

specialtyDining.title: Specialty & Premium Dining
specialtyDining.subtitle: ELEVATED CULINARY EXPERIENCES
specialtyDining.description: Celebrity Xcel also offers specialty and premium culinary experiences. Menus, pricing, and reservation requirements vary by sailing.

barsAndLounges.title: Bars, Lounges and Drinks
barsAndLounges.subtitle: Xcel includes a variety of social spaces for coffee, cocktails, casual drinks, and evening entertainment.

cards.title: Cocktail & Lounge Bars
cards.description: Evening social spaces designed for expertly crafted cocktails, pre-dinner drinks, and engaging conversations.

cards.title: Poolside Drinks
cards.description: Refreshing tropical cocktails, frozen drinks, and chilled beverages served directly around the pool deck.

cards.title: Coffee & Café Options
cards.description: Casual morning and afternoon spots serving specialty espresso, artisan coffees, teas, and fresh light bites.

cards.title: Destination Beverages
cards.description: Curated drink menus inspired by the regional ports, local distilleries, and wine regions on your itinerary.

cards.title: Evening Social Spaces
cards.description: Vibrant venues designed for after-dinner socializing, lively live music, dancing, and late-night nightlife.

cards.title: Premium Experiences
cards.description: Elevated drink selections, rare vintage spirits, sommelier tastings, and private mixology workshops.

barsAndLounges.beverageTip: If you are considering a beverage package, compare the package inclusions with the drinks you actually expect to order rather than assuming a package automatically provides better value.

thingsToDo.title: Things to Do on Celebrity Xcel
thingsToDo.subtitle: Celebrity Xcel is designed with a mixture of entertainment, relaxation, wellness, and destination-focused activities. Take advantage of unique Edge-series features right from the deck plans.

featuredHighlights.title: The Magic Carpet
featuredHighlights.description: A signature cantilevered platform that moves along the ship's side, offering changing viewpoints, dining venues, and tender boarding depending on the deck it's positioned on.

featuredHighlights.title: The Bazaar
featuredHighlights.description: A destination-themed culture hub combining local shopping, artisan foods, live entertainment, and experiences inspired by the specific ports of call.

featuredHighlights.title: Pools & Open Air
featuredHighlights.description: Expansive outdoor decks designed to bring you closer to the ocean, featuring modern pools, oversized hot tubs, private cabanas, and beautiful vistas.

featuredHighlights.title: Spa & Wellness
featuredHighlights.description: Dedicated wellness spaces, SEA Thermal Suite, and fitness options designed for active relaxation and recovery. Best booked in advance on sea days.

activityCards.title: Magic Carpet Experience
activityCards.description: Cantilevered floating platform that ascends from Deck 2 to Deck 16 with panoramic ocean vistas.

activityCards.title: The Bazaar Culture Hub
activityCards.description: Destination-inspired shopping, live music, and interactive regional festivities.

activityCards.title: Pools & Outdoor Decks
activityCards.description: Resort-style pool deck with modern loungers, hot tubs, and outward-facing views.

activityCards.title: Spa & Thermal Suites
activityCards.description: Comprehensive wellness treatments, therapy rooms, and recovery services.

activityCards.title: Live Performances
activityCards.description: Cutting-edge theater shows, live musical sets, and acrobatic artistry.

activityCards.title: Destination Activities
activityCards.description: Curated workshops, culinary demonstrations, and lectures connected to your voyage.

entertainment.title: Celebrity Xcel Entertainment
subtitles: Entertainment onboard is designed to extend beyond traditional theater performances, blending music, technology, and interactive events.
features: Theater Live Performances featuring world-class singers, dancers, and acrobats
Live Music & Lounges with jazz sets, acoustic guitarists, and DJ sets
Interactive Shows that immerse guests with 360-degree digital projection
Destination Programming connecting you with the culture of your ports
Social Theme Events and evening celebrations
Pool-Deck Parties under the Caribbean and Mediterranean stars
Active Nightlife across multiple bars, lounges, and late-night venues
entertainment.summary: Programming changes by itinerary and sailing date. Check your daily schedule in the Celebrity mobile app for accurate showtimes and venue locations.

itineraries.title: Where Does Celebrity Xcel Sail?
itineraries.subtitle: Celebrity currently lists Caribbean and European itineraries for Celebrity Xcel, offering warm island getaways and cultural Mediterranean journeys.

cards.title: Caribbean Voyages
cards.description: Warm-weather destinations, tropical beaches, island shore excursions, crystal-clear snorkeling waters, and plenty of relaxation outdoors under the sun.

cards.title: European Cruises
cards.description: Mediterranean and iconic European cruise regions, exploring historic ports, cultural monuments, world-renowned culinary capitals, and coastal scenery.

itineraries.tip: Tip: Caribbean routes focus on outdoor relaxation and beach stops, whereas European cruises emphasize history and sightseeing. Select based on your personal vacation style.

whoIsItFor.title: Who Is Celebrity Xcel Best Suited For?
whoIsItFor.subtitle: Celebrity Xcel is an excellent match for travelers who appreciate modern amenities, premium services, and stylish spaces. Note: While families are welcome, travelers looking for large-scale waterparks or rollercoasters might prefer comparing Xcel with mass-market family brands.

cards.title: Premium Cruising Experience

cards.title: Modern Accommodations

cards.title: Ocean Views & Open Air

cards.title: Specialty Dining & Varied Food
cards.description: Food lovers looking for diverse culinary concepts, chef-driven restaurants, and destination flavors.

cards.title: Wellness & Active Recovery

cards.title: Couples & Adult Getaways

cards.title: Edge Series Enthusiasts

fleetComparison.title: Celebrity Xcel vs. Other Edge Series Ships
fleetComparison.description: Celebrity Xcel belongs to the same Edge Series family as Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, Celebrity Beyond, and Celebrity Ascent. The ships share major design principles, but individual venues, dining concepts, itineraries, and onboard experiences can differ.
rows: Adds further dining and outdoor concepts
Builds on the series with newer experiences
fleetComparison.footer: Celebrity's fleet information identifies Xcel as the newest addition to the five-ship Edge Series currently listed by the cruise line.

planningFactors.title: Planning a Celebrity Xcel Cruise
planningFactors.subtitle: Compare these key factors before finalizing your booking details:

cards.title: Choose the Right Itinerary
cards.description: Look at ports, sea days, embarkation location, and total cruise length to match your preferred travel pace.
bullets: Balance sea days vs port days

cards.title: Compare Cabin Categories
cards.description: A cheaper cabin may provide less space or fewer benefits. An Infinite Veranda or suite may make sense for travelers who value the accommodation itself.

cards.title: Check Dining Options
cards.description: Review included and specialty dining choices before deciding whether additional dining reservations or packages are worthwhile.

cards.title: Review the Deck Plan
cards.description: Use the current deck plan to identify potential noise sources, elevator distance, and proximity to preferred public venues.

cards.title: Check What's Included
cards.description: Cruise fare inclusions can differ by fare type, promotion, cabin category, and specific sailing dates.

finalAssessment.title: Is Celebrity Xcel a Good Choice for Your Cruise?
subtitles: Celebrity Xcel is particularly worth considering if your priorities are modern design, premium cruising, innovative accommodations, varied dining, and destination-focused experiences.
The ship's Edge Series architecture gives it a distinctive identity, while the newer Xcel concepts expand on the features introduced aboard earlier Edge Series ships.
features: Innovative Infinite Verandas and luxury Retreat suites
Diverse dining from Spice Café to premium specialty venues
The Magic Carpet cantilevered viewpoint and venue
Exciting itineraries across the Caribbean and Europe
finalAssessment.summary: The best choice ultimately depends on your itinerary, preferred cabin, budget, dining priorities, and the type of onboard atmosphere you want.

faqs.question: When did Celebrity Xcel enter service?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Xcel's maiden voyage was on November 18, 2025, making it the newest ship in Celebrity Cruises' Edge Series.

faqs.question: How many decks does Celebrity Xcel have?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Xcel has 17 decks, according to Celebrity Cruises' current deck-plan information.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Xcel an Edge Series ship?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Xcel is the fifth ship in Celebrity Cruises' Edge Series, following Celebrity Edge, Apex, Beyond, and Ascent.

faqs.question: What is special about Celebrity Xcel?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Xcel combines the established Edge Series design with newer dining, entertainment, and destination-focused concepts. Its features include outward-facing spaces, Infinite Verandas, and the Magic Carpet.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Xcel have Infinite Veranda cabins?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Xcel offers Infinite Veranda staterooms, which use a floor-to-ceiling opening to create an indoor/outdoor-style connection with the sea.

faqs.question: How large are Celebrity Xcel Infinite Veranda rooms?
faqs.answer: Celebrity lists the referenced Infinite Veranda accommodation at approximately 243 square feet, including the integrated veranda space. Exact dimensions can vary by cabin category.

faqs.question: What restaurants are on Celebrity Xcel?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's current Xcel information highlights dining venues including Spice Café, Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, and Cyprus Restaurant, along with additional dining and specialty options.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Xcel have specialty dining?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Xcel offers specialty dining experiences in addition to its included dining venues. Specific restaurants, menus, prices, and reservation requirements can vary by sailing.

faqs.question: Where does Celebrity Xcel sail?
faqs.answer: Celebrity currently lists Celebrity Xcel itineraries in the Caribbean and Europe. Exact ports and cruise lengths depend on the sailing date and itinerary.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Xcel have the Magic Carpet?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Magic Carpet is one of the signature features associated with Celebrity's Edge Series and is part of the ship's distinctive design.

faqs.question: What cabin types are available on Celebrity Xcel?
faqs.answer: Cabin choices include Inside, Ocean View, Veranda, Infinite Veranda, and suite accommodations, with accessible staterooms also available.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Xcel good for couples?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Xcel can be a strong option for couples seeking contemporary design, premium dining, ocean views, wellness spaces, and a sophisticated cruise environment.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Xcel family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Families can sail on Celebrity Xcel, although the ship's overall positioning emphasizes premium design, dining, relaxation, and destination experiences.

faqs.question: How should I choose a Celebrity Xcel cabin?
faqs.answer: Start with your priorities—budget, balcony access, space, views, location, and suite benefits—then use the current deck plan to check nearby venues, elevators, public spaces, and potential sources of noise.

faqs.question: Where can I find Celebrity Xcel deck plans?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Cruises publishes the current Xcel deck plans through its official website. Travelers should use the latest version when choosing a specific stateroom.
